## Event Facility

The hackathon will be held at [ESA ESRIN](https://www.esa.int/establishment/about-us/meet-us/visit-esa/esa-esrin) in Frascati, a small town 20km south of Rome, Italy.
Power supply and WiFi access will be available at the venue.
Please ask at the Registration Desk for WiFi access credentials.
If you have non-European power plugs, please bring an appropriate adapter.

### Compute

Please bring your own laptop to work on at the hackathon.
You will have access to [JupyterHub compute platforms](resources/jupyterhubs.qmd) on [EarthCODE](https://earthcode.esa.int/ecosystem#accessible-computation-esa-and-partner-cloud-computing-platforms), which is a cloud-based environment for running Jupyter notebooks and other tools.

## Transportation

Travel to and from Frascati is the responsibility of the participants.
The closest international airport is Rome Fiumicino (FCO), which is approximately 50km from Frascati.
See [Getting to ESRIN](https://www.esa.int/articles/about-us/getting-to-esrin) for more information on how to get to Frascati from Rome.
Some travel support is available, and will be provided on a case-by-case basis.
See the [registration](registration.qmd) page for more information.

### Daily Courtesy Transport  

The ESRIN facility is located approximately 2.5km outside Frascati.
There will be a courtesy bus between Frascati and ESRIN on the schedule below. There is no bus to ESRIN on Monday morning, and no bus back to Frascati on Friday. The pick-up and drop-off point will be at [Piazza Guglielmo Marconi](https://maps.app.goo.gl/d58MdaqwnDBaw8xf8?g_st=ic).
The shuttle will have an ESA-ESRIN sign. If the bus is full, a second trip will be arranged.

| Date | Service | Route | Departure |
| :---- | :---- | :---- | :---- |
| Monday, 30 November | Evening | ESRIN → Piazza Guglielmo Marconi (Frascati) | 20:15 |
| Tuesday, 1 December | Morning | Piazza Guglielmo Marconi (Frascati) → ESRIN | 08:00 |
| Tuesday, 1 December | Evening | ESRIN → Piazza Guglielmo Marconi (Frascati) | 17:15 |
| Wednesday, 2 December | Morning | Piazza Guglielmo Marconi (Frascati) → ESRIN | 08:00 |
| Wednesday, 2 December | Evening | ESRIN → Piazza Guglielmo Marconi (Frascati) | 17:15 |
| Thursday, 3 December | Morning | Piazza Guglielmo Marconi (Frascati) → ESRIN | 08:00 |
| Thursday, 3 December | Evening | ESRIN → Piazza Guglielmo Marconi (Frascati) | 17:15 |
| Friday, 4 December | Morning | Piazza Guglielmo Marconi (Frascati) → ESRIN | 08:00 |

### Taxi

If you need a taxi, please book well in advance with Professional Car Service s.n.c. at <info@professionalcarservice.com>.
During the event, the Registration Desk can also book a taxi for you.

## Food

Coffee, tea, and water will be available during breaks in the Big Hall.
Lunch will be available in the ESRIN canteen from 12:15 to 13:00, Monday to Friday. Participants are responsible for the cost of their own meals.
On Monday, 30 November, there will be a hosted Icebreaker Aperitif in the Big Hall from 18:00 to 20:00.
Breakfast and dinner are not provided.
